center.note: Map centre only: mean of the drawn features' centroids; not a claim about any structure.

levels.name: Surface (reactor building; CONUS stood inside it)

name: Brokdorf — reactor building and the CONUS position
notes: The 'Reaktorgebaeude' polygon (way 87723028, 9227 m2, 130 m span) is the whole reactor-building complex, not the containment cylinder; its circular arc (radius 40.2 m) suggests the axis lies ~21 m SSW of the polygon centroid, but no source states the core position, so the CONUS point keeps the centroid with 40 m accuracy.

summary.plain: The Brokdorf reactor building, inside which the CONUS germanium detectors sat 17.1 m from the core until the plant closed at the end of 2021, with the turbine hall and the on-site interim fuel store.
summary.technical: Reactor-building footprint from OpenStreetMap (georeferenced); CONUS drawn as a derived point at the building centroid with accuracy widened for the unresolved 17.1 m offset (arXiv:2401.07684). The interim fuel store outline is cross-checked against BASE's stated 93 m x 27 m (perimeter, 6 %); the turbine hall is context.
